component.name: Earshot
component.summary: Charts, Reddit radio, albums and playlists, played from YouTube

description.p: Earshot is a desktop music player in the spirit of Headset: popular music by genre and era, a radio made of songs people share on Reddit, and YouTube as the music source, with real albums, artist pages and playlists.

ul.li: Charts for 20+ genres and every decade from the 50s to the 2020s
About 50 music subreddits as radio stations
YouTube playlists and timestamped soundtrack videos open as albums
Playlists, liked songs and saved albums kept on your computer
A mini player, a tray icon and a now-playing card

screenshot.caption: Home: trending songs, albums and charts

ul.li: YouTube searches put songs, music videos and albums first, and add YouTube Music's when YouTube's own results have little music in them.
A "Prefer music in YouTube results" setting.
The waveform hides while nothing plays.
Recent searches close when you click elsewhere.
